ideas.pitch: A hybrid quantum-classical post-quantum cryptography key distribution mesh network designed for secure edge-to-cloud telemetry in industrial IoT.
ideas.title: QuantumKey-Mesh
ideas.why_it_could_win: Leverages the theme of quantum technologies and cybersecurity organized by Q-Bits (the Quantum Technology Club), appealing directly to specialized technical judges looking for cryptographic depth rather than standard web apps.

ideas.pitch: An enterprise logistics routing dashboard that uses simulated quantum annealing algorithms to solve multi-depot vehicle routing problems in real-time.
ideas.title: Q-Route: Quantum-Annealed Supply Chain Optimizer
ideas.why_it_could_win: Combines advanced algorithmic problem solving (simulated quantum annealing) with a high-impact enterprise visualization dashboard, showing genuine technical rigor suitable for a national-level tech hackathon.

ideas.pitch: An edge-AI threat detection framework that combines graph intelligence and lightweight machine learning models to identify insider anomalies in zero-trust networks.
ideas.title: NeuroGuard-AI
ideas.why_it_could_win: Adopts the architecture of advanced risk detection and graph intelligence seen in top-tier hackathon winners, targeting the intersection of AI and cybersecurity.

ideas.pitch: An AI-powered satellite and drone imagery monitoring platform designed to verify agricultural carbon credits and land compliance automatically.
ideas.title: AgriQ-Sentry
ideas.why_it_could_win: Features clear, measurable environmental and economic impact backed by geospatial processing, a proven formula for winning judges looking for real-world utility.

ideas.pitch: An autonomous AI agent dispute resolution and escrow platform that automates multi-party micro-transactions with verifiable on-chain audit logs.
ideas.title: ChainEscrow-AI
ideas.why_it_could_win: Combines blockchain escrow infrastructure with autonomous agent workflows, delivering a live, working integration that showcases modern full-stack engineering.
